paper_title: Superradiance Exclusions in the Landscape of Type IIB String Theory
notes: This is a theoretical paper using black hole superradiance to constrain Type IIB string theory models. It does not present experimental or observational exclusions on axion couplings in canonical planes. The paper applies existing black hole observations (masses and spins) to constrain the axion mass and decay constant spectra of string models, but does not express results in standard AxionLimitBench coupling variables (e.g., g_aγγ vs m_a, g_ae vs m_a). The constraints are on theoretical string models rather than direct measurements of axion-matter couplings. Future work mentioned (Section 'Moving Beyond BHSR') suggests axion-photon coupling constraints could be derived but these are not explicitly presented in this work.
